description: Astrobiotix Labs — SpaceOps is a team of young innovators passionate about space, AI, and emerging technologies. We combine science, coding, creativity, and problem-solving to build innovative solutions for the future of human space exploration.
summary:
ARCADIA is an interactive Mars colonisation and survival game made by ASTROBIOTIX LABS – SpaceOps. It allows the user to see what astronauts may have to go through when trying to colonise Mars.

The game enables the user to navigate around Mars, manage resources such as oxygen, water, food and electricity, plan rover missions and learn the importance of creating a sustainable colony.

ARCADIA helps overcome this issue by allowing the user to gain a better understanding of how complex space exploration and survival can be by making it interactive. You can see how it all fits together and what decisions will be needed to keep the colony alive.

This is an important project as it helps encourage scientific curiosity, problem solving and shows the user the challenges that would occur when sending humans to Mars in the future.
details:
ARCADIA was created by our team ASTROBIOTIX LABS - SpaceOps as a colonisation and survival simulator designed to give insight into how humans may be able to live on Mars.

Our idea was to give people some insight into the challenges they may face when trying to create and maintain a human settlement on another planet. You get to explore the Martian environment, manage key resources (oxygen, water, food and power), and plan missions using rovers. Alongside this, we also show how important research, infrastructure and resource management is.

We believe ARCADIA can help to make space science more interesting. Providing an interactive learning experience, it will appeal to those interested in space, including students.

Our intention is to pique peoples interest in space, improve their problem solving skills and make them think about the challenges of sending humans to Mars in the future.

During our development we used C++ and OpenGL to create our Windows based prototype. We looked into creating a 3D web based simulator to create the interactive Martian environment. We used AI tools to help us during development.

What makes our project stand out is the combination of exploration, survival and colony management. We thought about key factors such as resource limitations, conditions, astronaut safety, sustainability and the challenges of being far away from Earth.

Ultimately, we want to improve our game to provide a more detailed and realistic simulation of Mars to help teach people about the future of human space exploration.
